svg.title: What Lease Structure Is Worth: The Ohio Renegotiation
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-ohio-tower-lease-structure-waterfall; chapter number: 3; title: What Lease Structure Is Worth: The Ohio Renegotiation; subtitle: Unwinding over $6,000 a month back to the original $900; caption: Vertical Consultants' Ohio client went from about $900 to about $2,000 a month, and the structured lease now pays over $6,000; a rent-only deal with a 3% escalator would sit near $2,700 to $2,800.; assumptions note: Endpoints are Hugh Odum's reported figures. The rent-only subtotal uses the midpoint of his $2,700 to $2,800 range; deductions are the gaps between his stated figures. Odum's rule of thumb that $1 of monthly rent equals roughly $1,000 of lease value frames the stakes of each step.; note: Source: Vertical Consultants, Hugh Odum (F1m9euwLJAQ @ 00:25:01, 00:19:51, 00:04:23).; chart type: waterfall; bars: label: Structured Lease Eight Years On; value: 6000; display: Over $6,000/mo; kind: total; label: Remove Tower-Value Participation; value: 3250; display: -$3,200 to -$3,300/mo; kind: deduction; label: Rent-Only Path With 3% Escalator; value: 2750; display: $2,700 to $2,800/mo; kind: total; label: Remove Eight Years of 3% Escalation; value: 750; display: -$700 to -$800/mo; kind: deduction; label: Remove the Renegotiated Base Lift; value: 1100; display: -$1,100/mo; kind: deduction; label: Original Rent Before Renegotiation; value: 900; display: About $900/mo; kind: result
